model: ECHOGEAR EGLL2 Low Profile Fixed Mount
connectivity: Concrete and block with appropriate fasteners
features: Holds up to 150lb — the highest capacity of any fixed mount here
Sits just 2.25 inches from the wall
UL certified and load-tested to four times its rated weight
Pull-string bracket release for reaching ports behind the TV
Drill template and pre-divided hardware included

specs.swivelRange: None — but the TV slides laterally on the wall plate to centre it
specs.studSpacing: Minimum 16-inch wood or steel studs; concrete requires 16-inch minimum fastener spacing
specs.levelAdjustment: Post-install levelling is advertised but ECHOGEAR does not publish a figure in degrees
specs.cableManagement: No raceway; the pull-string release tilts the TV forward for port access

pros: 150lb capacity and VESA 600x400 handle essentially any consumer TV up to 90 inches
2.25 inches from the wall gives an almost flush, wall-art look
UL certified and load-tested to four times its rating, with public install documentation
Lateral slide means you can still centre the TV even if your studs are not
cons: No tilt at all — a poor choice above a fireplace or anywhere you sit below the screen
Requires two studs, so single-stud installations are out
No cable management raceway
ECHOGEAR does not publish a levelling figure
shortTagline: 150lb capacity, 2.25 inches from the wall, and properly documented.

features: 132lb capacity and VESA 600x400 at under $30

specs.studSpacing: 16, 18 and 24-inch on-centre wood studs, plus concrete and block walls

pros: 132lb capacity and VESA 600x400 for under $30 is the aggressive end of the value tier

SANUS publishes no levelling range in degrees
SANUS and retailer spec tables state the tilt range differently
